subject.title: Isolated cron consistently fails with "LLM request failed" on model-call-started phase

question: Should this broad isolated-cron report remain the umbrella tracker while maintainers settle the watchdog, stream-stall, and recovery-policy subpaths, or should it be split/closed in favor of narrower issues?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes and source-visible remaining behavior, but the remaining symptoms cross timeout policy, provider fallback, and session recovery; automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Keep this issue open as the user-facing regression tracker and require live affected-cron proof before queueing another fix branch.

options.title: Split To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Move discussion to the narrower watchdog and stream-progress issues, then close this only after those trackers explicitly preserve this report's latest evidence.

options.title: Sponsor A Recovery Policy
options.body: Ask an owner to define whether consecutive cron errors should trigger an explicit reset or doctor-style recovery before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the user-facing regression tracker and require live affected-cron proof before queueing another fix branch.

likelyOwner.reason: The cron service/watchdog boundary history and maintainer-facing product decision are closest to the cron timer refactor and review path associated with this person.
